rulings.S-PREP-P1 (accepted): A gm-branded spectator seat, including a co-op campaign host seated as spectator (pages/api/multiplayer/matches/index.ts defaultSeatsWithSpectatorHost + campaign-session gm row), receives sealed declarations on live and replay only once authoritatively revealed. This matches HTTP (FogAwareMatchProjection already excludes spectator seats) and the registered contract ("even with a stale sideAssignments entry or a gm-branded viewer"; "preserve non-spectating GM policy"). A seated (non-spectating) gm keeps pre-reveal visibility. The L1 two-players-plus-GM coop mission is unaffected: coopMissionCreate mission metadata carries no seats and no coopCampaign, so no viewer there is a spectator or gm-branded. Recorded for the full review to assess.
rulings.S-PREP-P2 (accepted): MovementDeclared is driven by real intents (sealedChoiceDelivery.test.ts). AttackDeclared and PhysicalAttackDeclared rows use real payload shapes (IAttackDeclaredPayload / IPhysicalAttackDeclaredPayload) sent through the host's own broadcastEvent seam for live, and the same event appended to the store and served by the real host.sendReplay / handleSessionJoin for replay. Actor ownership, the membership source and the publication boundary are not mocked. Rationale: driving a real weapon or physical attack to an unrevealed declaration needs combat setup beyond the two registered test leaves; doing so would need a new test leaf and an amendment, and the decision under test (sealed audience at the boundary) is identical for all three types.
